name: Nowah
tagline: Plan and book your trip with an AI travel agent.
description: Nowah is an AI travel app that helps you plan and book trips in one conversation. Build personalized itineraries, search and book live flights, and turn travel reels into mapped plans. Stay prepared with eSIMs, visa checks, flight tracking and price alerts. Available on the web, iPhone and Android, with a free plan to get started.
